facts.text: Glenview was incorporated in 1899, growing from a modest farming community into a village with more than 125 years of history.
When the post office demanded an official name, residents chose 'Glenview' from options like Rugenville and Glenvarr during a special meeting.
Naval Air Station Glenview served Coast Guard rescue helicopters and antisubmarine P‑3 Orions from the 1940s until its 1995 closure.
After the base closed, the 1,121‑acre former NAS was converted into “The Glen,” a mixed‑use development covering about 15% of the village.
The Grove prairie hosts an interpretive center, historic buildings, and nature trails, letting visitors explore Glenview’s natural heritage.
The Glenview History Center, located in the historic State Bank, curates artifacts, maps, and oral histories to preserve the village’s story.
